title: Portal to Drowning
description: A surreal underwater scene featuring a glowing blue portal framed by ancient runes. To the left, a hooded figure in futuristic black armor with blue neon accents stands beside a woman in a white suit holding a small white dog. In the center, a muscular blue demonic creature with horns emerges from the portal. To the right, a woman in a black futuristic suit is submerged upside down in dark water.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene set in an underwater gallery with a large glowing blue portal covered in ancient runes that reads PORTAL TO DROWNING. A blue horned demonic creature with glowing eyes emerges from the portal splashing water. To the left stands a tall figure in black hooded armor with bright blue neon circuit patterns next to a woman in a white suit holding a small white fluffy dog. On the right a woman in a black futuristic suit is drowning upside down in dark blue water. Cinematic lighting, ethereal atmosphere.
